en: "Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
"Tch.{n} So the enemy made off with the chest!"
"O blazing flames,{n} become a storm and destroy the foe..."
"...Deadly lightning, become a flash{n} piercing heaven and earth, and show{n} the murderous foe your true power..."
"...Thunder wind, become a blade raging{n} in the air, and show the horde{n} writhing on the ground your true power..."
"...Absolute ice, become storm fangs{n} that shake heaven and earth, and show{n} the oncoming malice your true power..."
"Water of light,{n} become a shield and guard us."
"Wall! O wall of swirling flame!{n} Bar the enemy's way and{n} grant us the power of protection!"
"Hear my name! Call my name!{n} A proud name, filled with glory!"
"Race across the sky! Pierce the heavens!{n} The ultra-long shot... Range Plus!"
"This one's no ordinary bullet!{n} Round in the chamber!{n} Hammer cocked! Target!"
"Rocks in the sky, clouds on the ground!{n} ......Art of Falling Rocks!"
"The gates connect, O eight gates!{n} ...Art of the Strange Gates...{n} Earth Formation!"
"Magic and strikes, be sealed!{n} Battle arts, be shut away{n} by the Law of Sealing!"
"Come, dragon, dragon of the earth!{n} Open, Gate of Death! Lead on to hell!"
"Come forth... my minions...{n} puppets of the dead...{n} The word that wakes you... Doll..."
"That's right. The game with the rings{n} at stake."
"There's just one rule!{n} The winner of the fight gets only{n} one of the other side's rings!"
"Will you accept a fight with{n} the rings at stake?"
"Oh my, what's wrong, {name:6}?{n} Got cold feet or something?"
"Maybe so. But I felt that now{n} isn't the time to fight."
"Well, that's your way of living too.{n} But someday the time will come to{n} settle it. You know that much, right?"
"Yes. Next time we meet, for sure."
"It can't be helped. For now,{n} finding the remaining rings{n} comes first."
"But as long as they've got rings{n} too, at this rate we'll never{n} get all 12 together, you know?"
"I know. I know an all-out showdown{n} is a fate we can't escape."
"You'll accept the fight?{n} Hmph... don't be stupid."
"Isn't it obvious? You haven't{n} collected enough rings to bet.{n} Fighting your sort wastes my time."
"No, if anything, it'd be our loss."
"That is certainly true.{n} Right now, the rings we hold{n} number only one..."
"Get lost. We've got no business{n} with you people."
"Go wander around this island{n} all you like and get as many{n} rings into your hands as you can!"
"Diana's right. When that time comes,{n} you'll finally have earned the right{n} to be killed by us."
"You bastard! Running your mouth{n} however you like!"
"'Right to be killed', my ass!? Bastard!{n} I'll wrench those rings off you{n} right here and now!"
"Heh. You may be good with a sword,{n} but you're as short-tempered{n} as ever..."
"Anyway, let's look for the rings.{n} At this rate, the Almighty Treasure{n} will fall into their hands."
"I know that. But, {name:6},{n} don't you ever forget this."
"We may have joined hands for now,{n} but I'm not on this journey{n} to seal away the Almighty Treasure."
"Of course. I believe I understand thaat."
"So, how do you want to fight?"
"Then this is the battlefield!{n} With both sides' rings at stake!"
"{name:6}, sorry, but{n} this one's going to be my win!"
"Please give up, Diana! We will{n} never lose! Not until we have sealed{n} away the Almighty Treasure!"
"Ha! You don't know what things are{n} worth, do you!? Love for your hubby{n} matters more than a god's power?"
"Makes my skin crawl! It's because of{n} women who think like you that men{n} are always conning women!"
"When I look at you, I remember{n} who I used to be, and it makes{n} me sick to my stomach!"
"Me, back when I was an innocent{n} girl still dreaming about love!"
"Here I come, Diana!{n} Now I will show you the{n} swordplay of the Holy Knight!"
"Then before you show it, I'll{n} blow a hole right through that{n} pretty face of yours!"
"If that's what you intend, Diana,{n} then I won't hold back either!"
"Of course not! This is a battlefield!"
"I will kill you.{n} Because I hated you, so blessed{n} from the day you were born."
"Her mind is still being controlled.{n} No...? Could it be that{n} this is how she truly feels?"
"It's no use. Her mind is still{n} controlled by that secret drug{n} of the ancient civilization..."
"I'm sorry, Aerial! Even if your mind{n} is being controlled, I never thought{n} I'd end up fighting you!"
"Ngh...{w:1} please, Hector...{n} give me...{w:1} strength...{n} the strength to fight...{w:1} a while longer..."
"Mr. {hero:6}, please wait for us.{n} We will get that ring,{n} I promise you..."
"I am {name:6} the Holy Knight!{n} I cannot fall from{n} a wound like this!"
"But I'm not so soft that I'd be beaten{n} by {name:6}, the sheltered{n} young lady, and her friends!"
"Gh!? Well, damn. I've been through{n} plenty of fire in my time,{n} but this one looks a little dicey..."
"Heh, not yet, {name:6}!{n} An attack like this{n} isn't going to put me down!"
"I'll be taking the ring{n} of the Twelve Gods."
"Next time...{w:1} I'll beat you...{n} for sure...{w:1} {name:6}."
"Heh, I've got the ring, all right.{n} This glow brings Ixion and me{n} one more step closer to godhood."
"Hey, you okay?{n} Don't tell me you're{n} gonna die on me."
"Tch, all right, my foot.{n} Your face is white as a sheet."
"Well, I picked up a few wounds too.{n} Time's precious, but I guess{n} we'll just pitch camp here..."
"What? Hurry up and go to sleep!"
"Thank you...{w:1} for doing this for me..."
"Idiot, don't get the wrong idea.{n} I'm a murdering Dark Knight.{n} Who'd ever worry about you?"
"I've been killing people{n} with these hands since I was eight."
"If I push you and you die on me,{n} I'll sleep badly, that's all.{n} So we're pitching camp here."
"Everyone else...{w:1} is wounded too.{n} Let's...{w:1} rest here for a while."
"Diana, this game of yours{n} ends here! Please hand over{n} the last ring!"
"No way!{n} You think it'll be that easy?"
"You're as big a fool{n} as ever, {name:6}!"
"Diana, you play a game with people's{n} lives at stake, then break its rules!{n} I can't forgive that!"
"If keeping the rules got you the{n} Almighty Treasure, it'd be easy.{n} The point is, just don't lose."
"Ixion, you bastard,{n} dirty to the very end!"
"You'll never understand. Whatever{n} it takes, all that matters is winning{n} in the end. Justice is the victor's."
"Farewell, fools.{n} If we can, let's play{n} another fun game next time!"
"Diana!{n} Will the day never come{n} when we understand each other?"
